name: כלל המנה – xⁿ/(1−x) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Differentiate \(\displaystyle {{CT:0}}\) with respect to {{CT:1}}.

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
The quotient rule

In order to solve this problem we will have to use the quotient rule as follows:

The quotient rule: \( \frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2} \)

\[ \begin{aligned} \frac{d}{d{{CT:2}}}\left({{CT:0}}\right) &= \frac{\left[\frac{d}{d{{CT:2}}}({{CT:3}})\right]\cdot ({{CT:4}}) - ({{CT:3}})\cdot \left[\frac{d}{d{{CT:2}}}({{CT:4}})\right]}{({{CT:4}})^2} \\ &= \frac{\left[{{CT:5}}\right]\cdot ({{CT:4}}) - ({{CT:3}})\cdot \left({{CT:6}}\right)}{({{CT:4}})^2} \\ &= \frac{{{CT:7}} - \left({{CT:8}}\right)}{({{CT:4}})^2} \\ &= \frac{{CT:9}}{({{CT:4}})^2} \\ &= {{CT:10}} \end{aligned} \]

on_true.feedback: To differentiate a quotient use the rule \[\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f}{g}\right] = \frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\] You cannot get the derivative of a quotient by dividing the derivatives.
